youtube.addModerator.description: Makes a viewer a moderator of your live YouTube chat. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

parameters.user: The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast.

youtube.addTags.description: Adds tags to your YouTube broadcast. Tags it already has are kept, and doubles are skipped.

parameters.tags: The tags to add, as a list like ["gaming", "chill"] or as text with commas, like "gaming, chill".
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.addTags.returns: The full list of tags the video has now.

youtube.banUser.description: Bans a viewer from your live YouTube chat for good. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

parameters.user: The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast.

youtube.clearTags.description: Removes every tag from your YouTube broadcast.

parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.clearTags.returns: The list of tags the video has now (empty).

youtube.createPoll.description: Starts a poll in your live YouTube chat. It needs a question and 2 to 4 options.

parameters.question: The question, like "Which game next?"
parameters.options: The answers, as a list like ["Minecraft", "Fortnite"] or as text with commas.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast.

youtube.createPoll.returns: The id of the poll message. You can give it to youtube.endPoll.

youtube.deleteMessage.description: Deletes one message from your YouTube chat. Fails when YouTube is not connected or the id is empty.

parameters.messageId: The id of the chat message, like the %messageId% of a chat trigger.

youtube.endPoll.description: Ends a YouTube chat poll. Fails when there is no active poll.

parameters.pollMessageId: Optional. The poll id from youtube.createPoll. Leave it out for the poll Cuebot started last.

youtube.getBot.description: Gives you the details of your YouTube bot account, as set on the YouTube page.
youtube.getBot.returns: An object with userName, userId, customUrl, profileImageUrl and isSignedIn.

youtube.getBroadcaster.description: Gives you the details of your own YouTube account, as set on the YouTube page.
youtube.getBroadcaster.returns: An object with userName, userId, customUrl, profileImageUrl and isSignedIn.

youtube.getChannelInfo.description: Looks up a YouTube channel. Fails when you are not signed in or the channel cannot be found.

parameters.user: The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently.

youtube.getChannelInfo.returns: An object with id, title, description, customUrl, url, profileImageUrl, subscriberCount, subscriberCountHidden, videoCount, viewCount and createdAt.

youtube.getLatestMonitoredBroadcast.description: Gives you the newest live broadcast Cuebot is watching.
youtube.getLatestMonitoredBroadcast.returns: The broadcast with id, title, description, privacy, status, liveChatId, url, actualStart, actualEnd, scheduledStart, channelId and thumbnailUrl. null when none is being watched.

youtube.getMonitoredBroadcasts.description: Lists every live broadcast Cuebot is watching right now.
youtube.getMonitoredBroadcasts.returns: A list of broadcasts, each with id, title, description, privacy, status, liveChatId, url, actualStart, actualEnd, scheduledStart, channelId and thumbnailUrl. Empty when there are none.

youtube.getQuota.description: Shows how much of your daily YouTube allowance (quota) Cuebot has used. YouTube limits how many requests you can make per day.
youtube.getQuota.returns: An object with used (units used today, an estimate), dailyQuota, exhausted (true when none is left) and resetsAt (when it starts over).

youtube.getVideoInfo.description: Looks up a YouTube video, with live numbers like viewers and likes. Fails when you are not signed in or the video cannot be found.

parameters.videoId: Optional. The video id, like "dQw4w9WgXcQ". Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.getVideoInfo.returns: An object with id, title, description, url, channelId, channelTitle, categoryId, tags, privacy, liveStatus, thumbnail, concurrentViewers, viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, actualStart and actualEnd.

youtube.removeModerator.description: Takes moderator away from a viewer in your live YouTube chat. Fails when they are not a moderator.

parameters.user: The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast.

youtube.removeTags.description: Removes some tags from your YouTube broadcast. Upper or lower case does not matter.

parameters.tags: The tags to remove, as a list like ["chill"] or as text with commas.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.removeTags.returns: The full list of tags the video has now.

youtube.sendMessage.description: Sends a message in your live YouTube chat. Text over 200 characters is split. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

parameters.message: What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!"
parameters.useBot: Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself.
parameters.fallback: Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in or fails; false makes it fail instead.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast.

youtube.sendMessageToLatestMonitored.description: Sends a message in the chat of your newest live YouTube broadcast. Text over 200 characters is split. Fails when you are not live.

parameters.message: What to say, like "Welcome to the stream!"
parameters.useBot: Optional. true sends it with your bot account. Leave it out to send as yourself.
parameters.fallback: Optional. With useBot, true (the default) sends as yourself when the bot is not signed in or fails; false makes it fail instead.

youtube.setCategory.description: Changes the category of your YouTube broadcast. YouTube uses number ids for categories, like "20" for Gaming.

parameters.categoryId: The category id, like "20" (Gaming) or "22" (People & Blogs).
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.setDescription.description: Changes the description of your YouTube broadcast.

parameters.description: The new description, like "Playing with chat tonight!"
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.setMetadata.description: Changes the title, the description, or both, of your YouTube broadcast in one go. What you leave out stays as it is.

parameters.title: Optional. The new title. Leave it out (or empty) to keep it.
parameters.description: Optional. The new description. Leave it out to keep it.
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.setPrivacy.description: Changes who can see your YouTube broadcast.

parameters.privacy: "public" (everyone), "unlisted" (only people with the link) or "private" (only you).
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.setTitle.description: Changes the title of your YouTube broadcast. Fails when you are not signed in or there is no live or upcoming broadcast.

parameters.title: The new title, like "Chill games with chat".
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The video id of the broadcast to change. Leave it out for your live broadcast (or the next upcoming one).

youtube.timeoutUser.description: Times out a viewer in your live YouTube chat for some seconds. Fails when YouTube is not connected or you are not live.

parameters.user: The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently.
parameters.duration: Optional. How long, in seconds, like 300. Leave it out for 300 (5 minutes).
parameters.broadcastId: Optional. The id of a monitored broadcast. Leave it out for your latest live broadcast.

youtube.unbanUser.description: Lifts a ban or timeout. YouTube only lets Cuebot undo bans it placed itself since it started; use YouTube Studio for older ones.

parameters.user: The viewer: their channel id (starts with UC), their @handle, or the name of someone who chatted recently.

youtube.unbanUser.returns: Nothing. Fails when Cuebot did not ban this viewer in this session.
